about: The event takes place at Alfred B. Maclay Gardens State Park, 3540 Thomasville Road in Tallahassee, and the park lists the Visitor Center as the place to start. The Friends of Maclay Gardens, the park's support group, serve the hot cider and cookies.

Florida State Parks says the house is decorated for this night only, with fresh Christmas greenery and white camellias, so the Maclay House looks different from a regular visit. The evening also includes a silent auction and live music performances in addition to Santa.
faq: Is Camellia Christmas free?
Florida State Parks lists it as a free community event from 6 to 9 PM on December 4, 2026, and donations are accepted by the Friends of Maclay Gardens.
Can kids meet Santa at Camellia Christmas?
Yes. The park's event listing says guests can visit with Santa during the evening.
Who do I contact with questions?
The park lists MaclayEventCoordinator@FloridaDEP.gov as the contact for this event.

about: The Villa Zorayda Museum sits at 83 King Street, across from Flagler College and west of the Lightner Museum. The building dates to 1883, and the museum says it was built as a private residence without electricity or plumbing, which is part of why the candlelight setting suits it.

The museum sells Candlelight Tour tickets only on its website or in person at the museum, and all tickets are subject to availability. It strongly suggests buying ahead, and it says discounts and promotions do not apply to special events.

Parking is not complimentary for these tours. The museum points guests to its public parking page and recommends arriving downtown early during Nights of Lights to avoid heavy traffic. Questions go to 904-829-9887 or info@villazorayda.com.

Ticket prices are $26.99 for adults and $14.99 for children ages 6 to 12, plus 6.5% sales tax. The museum says its audio guided tour covers the home's 140 years of history along with its art and antique collection, and guests should expect to stand and walk for the full hour.

Candlelight Tours are offered only during St. Augustine's Nights of Lights, which the museum says runs from November into January. If none of the Candlelight dates fit your trip, the museum lists its Holiday Evening Tours on select Saturdays as the alternative.
faq: How long is the Candlelight Tour?
The museum says it lasts about 60 minutes, and guests who leave early miss the tree lighting and the beverage and cookie.
Are Candlelight Tours good for young children?

Families are welcome, but the museum does not recommend this tour for ages 5 and under because of the 60 minute length. Children must stay with their adults, and it points families to the Holiday Evening Tours for a more flexible visit.
Can I get a refund on Candlelight Tour tickets?
No. The museum says this is a limited ticket event and all tickets are nonrefundable.
Is there an elevator?
No. The museum says the historic building has no elevator, and the tour covers 2 levels with one stairway.
Can a group book a private Candlelight Tour?
Yes. Private Candlelight Tours need at least 35 guests and are booked through info@villazorayda.com.
How much are Candlelight Tour tickets?
Adults are $26.99 and children ages 6 to 12 are $14.99, plus 6.5% sales tax, according to the museum.
Is parking included?
No. The museum cannot offer complimentary parking for these tours, and daily paid parking is first come, first served.

about: Holiday Evening Tours run on Saturday evenings and are the museum's open admission option during Nights of Lights. Admission is $19.00 for adults and $12.00 for ages 5 to 12, and children 4 and under are free, all plus 6.5% sales tax.
The audio tour is included in English, Spanish or French. The museum notes that audio guides must be held to the ear, that it does not provide headphones, and that guests may bring their own.
The museum rules ask guests not to bring food, beverages, umbrellas or strollers inside, and children must be supervised at all times. Large bags are left with the attendant at the front.

Regular daytime admission is separate. The museum's general admission is $17.00 for adults and $9.00 for ages 5 to 12 as of November 1, 2026, and it is closed on Thanksgiving, Christmas Eve and Christmas Day. These Saturday evening dates use the special event prices instead.

The museum describes the standing and walking involved as about 45 minutes. Because the building has two levels and one flight of stairs, guests with mobility needs are asked to tell the attendant at the entrance, and a wheelchair entrance is available at the rear with staff help.
Groups of 35 or more can arrange private evening holiday tours in advance by calling 904-829-9887 or emailing info@villazorayda.com.
faq: What time do Holiday Evening Tours start?
There is no fixed start. Doors open from 5:15 to 7 PM for admission, and the museum closes at 8 PM.
How long should we plan for the visit?
The typical tour is 45 minutes, and the museum suggests allowing 1 hour.
How are Holiday Evenings different from Candlelight Tours?
Holiday Evenings are self guided and go at your own pace. Candlelight Tours run about 60 minutes at set times and end with a tree lighting and a complimentary beverage and cookie.
Where do I buy tickets?
Tickets are sold only on the museum's website or in person at the museum, and discounts do not apply to these special events.
Is there a discount for St. Johns County residents?
The museum's resident discount applies to general admission only, so it does not cover these special event evenings.
Can we bring a stroller?
The museum rules do not permit strollers inside, and small children must be held for the duration of the tour.
